description: Utility for managing a collection of encrypted secrets in source control
##: The Windows release assets are tar.gz archives whose payload is flat: ejson.exe plus README, CHANGELOG and LICENSE. There is no installer and nothing to clean up.
Both amd64 and arm64 Windows builds are published; the hashes were taken from ejson_1.6.0_checksums.txt and verified against the downloaded archives.
autoupdate.hash is omitted: the GitHub release assets publish sha256 digests that Excavator reads through the API.
The keypair lives in $env:EJSON_KEYDIR (or ~/.ejson/keys by default), outside the app directory, so nothing needs persisting.
